title: Break the Dead Congregation
description: The cathedral template contains armed Zombies, Skeletons, and Zombie spawners. Break a representative body of those defenders inside the Cursed Cathedral. Questlog deliberately does not invent a Church of Sin boss or faction that the installed mod does not contain.
description_completed: The dead congregation has been bloodied and the cathedral's finite expedition is concluded. Whatever remains inside is plunder, not a hidden second campaign.

objectives.name: Destroy four Zombies inside the cathedral
Destroy two Skeletons inside the cathedral
